facts.claim: GitHub Copilot offers a free individual plan ($0/month) with limited chat and agent usage.
GitHub Copilot Pro costs $10/month for individuals and includes $15/month worth of GitHub AI Credits.
GitHub Copilot Pro+ costs $39/month for individuals and includes $70/month worth of GitHub AI Credits.
GitHub Copilot Max costs $100/month for individuals and includes $200/month worth of GitHub AI Credits.

GitHub Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise are organization-level plans that include per-user GitHub AI Credits allowances, billed at 1 AI credit = $0.01 USD once included allowances are exceeded.
facts.source_name: GitHub Docs (Models and pricing for GitHub Copilot)

facts.claim: Cursor offers a free 'Hobby' plan requiring no credit card, providing limited Agent requests and access to Composer.
Cursor's individual paid plans start at $20/month, with Pro+, and Ultra tiers offering extended usage limits, frontier model access, and other features on top of the base Pro tier.

Cursor's Teams plan is priced at $40 per user per month and adds centralized team billing/administration, team marketplace, cloud agents with shared context, agentic code reviews, usage analytics, team-wide privacy mode, and SAML/OIDC SSO.

Cursor's Enterprise plan uses custom pricing and includes everything in Teams plus pooled usage, invoice/PO billing, SCIM seat management, repository and model access controls, audit logs, an AI code tracking API, and priority support.
Claude Code is included in Anthropic's Claude Pro plan, which costs $20/month billed monthly or $17/month ($200 billed up front) with an annual subscription.
Claude Code is included in Anthropic's Claude Max plan, which starts from $100/month and offers two usage tiers (5x and 20x the Pro usage).

Anthropic's Claude Team plan has two seat tiers, both of which include Claude Code: Team Standard at $20/seat/month billed annually ($25/seat/month billed monthly), and Team Premium at $100/seat/month billed annually ($125/seat/month billed monthly).
